answer: Sybil resistance hinges on identity-bound economic staking. Each unique AI agent must immutably stake a quantifiable amount of network tokens. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities would need to acquire and lock an equivalent sum for each, causing a significant ripple effect on token value. This economic barrier ensures that the cost for an attacker to reach a critical mass, a true summit of fake identities, becomes prohibitive. A diligent falcon mechanism monitors for anomalous staking patterns, flagging potential attacks.
